WITH ip AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM dim_product WHERE subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
)
SELECT p.sku, p.product_key, p.product_name, p.category, p.subcategory, p.is_current, CAST(p.valid_from AS VARCHAR) vf, CAST(p.valid_to AS VARCHAR) vt, CAST(p.delisted_on AS VARCHAR) dl
FROM dim_product p JOIN ip USING (sku)
WHERE p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku HAVING count(*) > 1 OR count(DISTINCT subcategory) > 1)
ORDER BY p.sku, p.valid_from

calls.statement:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at, s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
)
SELECT count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS distinct_line_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines,
  sum(quantity) AS units, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units,
  min(quantity) AS minq, max(quantity) AS maxq, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads,
  min(sale_date) AS first_day, max(sale_date) AS last_day, count(DISTINCT sale_date) AS days, sum(net_amount) AS net
FROM base

WITH fact AS (
  SELECT sum(f.quantity) AS fact_units, sum(f.net_amount) AS fact_net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS fact_receipts
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
),
rpt AS (
  SELECT sum(units_sold) AS rpt_units, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_net, sum(receipts) AS rpt_receipts, count(*) AS rpt_days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id = 108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
),
ret AS (
  SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) AS ret_units_ip
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT * FROM fact, rpt, ret
